author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
At Tony Swatton's workshop, Adam can't help but be drawn to this miniature suit of armor! Tony explains the origins of this piece, what it took to make it, and why it's actually harder to make a child's armor than a full-sized suit. 

Find Tony Swatton's builds at https://thetonyswatton.com/ and subscribe to his new channel at https://www.youtube.com/@TheTonySwatton 

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
